description: Version awareness. Revision 1.0 of the AX-200 manual says 28 ft-lb and 3.8 lb of charge; revision 2.1 supersedes it with 35 ft-lb and 4.2 lb. Citing the superseded figure is indistinguishable from a hallucination to the technician holding the wrench.

cases.why: The superseded manual is still in the corpus and is topically a perfect match. It must never be cited by default.
Same trap on a different figure.
Servicing an older serial range is a real need. Excluded by default, reachable on purpose.
